title: Cirro 1.2.0
summary: A smoother, more personal Cirro experience across Windows and Android.

items.title: Biometric app lock on Android
items.description: Protect Cirro with your phone’s fingerprint or face unlock. Turn App lock on from Settings → Privacy.

items.title: Search history
items.description: Quickly return to recent searches from the search field. Search history stays on your device and can be cleared at any time.

items.title: Access request before sign-in
items.description: If your Google account has not been approved for early access, choose Request access before continuing to Google sign-in.

items.title: Stay signed in
items.description: Cirro keeps your connected accounts available between launches and refreshes access when needed. A temporary connection problem no longer immediately signs you out.

items.title: Android app icon
items.description: The Cirro launcher icon now uses a cleaner blue background and a cloud mark with a Beta badge.

items.title: Account settings on Android
items.description: When you connect multiple accounts, Settings now shows them together in a compact account overview.
